1411921684555255809.a: Got sucked into a Youtube Squirrelhole, as it were. Interesting watching videos of "pet" squirrels. I have had a few squirrels that I suppose you might call pets. Though they never attempted to come indoors except to eat. I felt more like their pet, honestly.

1411921685603930115.a: You definitely should not kidnap a squirrel and try to make it your pet if that isn't obvious. If it's sick I think it's fine to help it out. Some squirrels tend to be pretty sociable with humans. They often try to communicate before resorting to burglary. 😜

1411921686618853380.a: If somehow you find a squirrel in your home... Just listen to what they need and give them space. Call a vet to make sure they aren't contagious or dying. Healthy squirrels will want back outdoors right away. But might visit you from then on. Sometimes not even wanting anything.

1411921687721938947.a: If the squirrel refuses to go out into nature it might be injured in some way that is not apparent. Again, make sure you check with a vet. Maybe it's family was killed, for example. It may not know how to function alone. The vet might know of a sanctuary that can take it.

1412127123540779011.a: Bought a new coop for the chickens Saturday. Woke up Sunday morning to swap the old one out... Found a missing chicken. Looked a bit staged to me like a person was trying to make it look like an animal got it. Built the coop for the remaining chicken. But then...

1412127124501188617.a: I wake up this morning and find a mouse next to my bed acting poisoned. Mice don't come indoors in summer... I tossed it out the door without thinking. Got up later to check the chicken in the new coop. She was laid out flat like she was poisoned twitching then died.

1412127125495336960.a: Someone had been in the new coop clearly because the water bowl had been moved. I eat those eggs. I've been super sick for a couple weeks. In case it's not clear poisoning someone's food supply can be considered attempted murder. Cameras are a hell of a thing.
